pi.frontmatter:
name: reply-brief
description: >-
  Answers briefly and reads clean: a bold verdict first, then at most three supports. Use when the question is why / how come / can it / is it enough, when only a root cause plus a fix is wanted, when checking whether something shipped, or as the default for a question that matches no more specific skill.
